name: Ausbruch Trader 1.0
summary: This EA implements a breakout trading strategy that identifies price range boundaries and enters positions when price breaks out of the established range. It places pending orders or market orders at range extremes with predefined stop-loss and take-profit levels, aiming to capture momentum-driven moves after a consolidation phase.
summary_zh: 该EA实现突破交易策略，通过识别价格区间的边界，在价格突破已确立的区间时入场建仓。它在区间极值处设置挂单或市价单，并预设止损和止盈水平，旨在捕捉盘整阶段后的动量驱动行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的突破策略概念，在价格盘整形成的区间上下轨突破时入场。入场条件通常为价格突破近期高点或低点一定距离后开仓，或在区间边界设置突破挂单。出场条件包括固定止盈止损、以及可选的追踪止损来锁定利润。仓位管理方面，EA可能提供固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式。资金管理可能包含最大持仓限制和连续亏损后的仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但突破策略在假突破行情中容易产生频繁止损，需要配合波动率过滤或成交量确认来提高胜率。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a classic breakout strategy concept, entering positions when price breaks above or below the boundaries of a consolidation range. Entry conditions typically involve price penetrating a recent high or low by a defined threshold, or placing breakout pending orders at range extremes. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with an optional trailing stop to lock in profits during favorable moves. Position sizing may use either a fixed lot size or a percentage-based calculation relative to account equity. Money management likely includes maximum position limits and potential lot reduction after consecutive losses. The overall strategy logic is straightforward, but breakout systems are vulnerable to false breakouts that cause frequent stop-outs, requiring volatility filters or volume confirmation to improve win rates.
pros: 突破策略逻辑清晰易懂，适合趋势明显的市场环境
具有明确的止损和止盈设置，风险可控
支持追踪止损功能，可以在趋势行情中锁定更多利润
突破交易在强趋势市场中盈亏比表现优秀
参数可调节，适应不同品种和时间周期
pros_en: Breakout strategy logic is clear and easy to understand, suitable for trending market conditions
Has explicit stop-loss and take-profit settings, keeping risk manageable
Supports trailing stop functionality to lock in more profits during trending moves
Breakout trading offers excellent risk-reward ratios in strong trending markets
Adjustable parameters allow adaptation to different instruments and timeframes
cons: 假突破行情中会产生频繁止损，降低整体盈利能力
缺乏波动率过滤机制，可能在低波动时段产生无效信号
无新增K线检测可能导致同一根K线上重复开仓
固定点数止损未考虑不同品种的波动率差异
未提供资金管理百分比仓位计算选项
cons_en: Frequent stop-outs from false breakouts reduce overall profitability
Lacks volatility filter mechanism, potentially generating invalid signals during low-volatility periods
Absence of new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same candle
Fixed pip-based stop-loss doesn't account for volatility differences across instruments
No percentage-based position sizing option for money management
improvements: 增加ATR波动率过滤，避免在低波动时段入场
加入新增K线检测逻辑，防止同一根K线重复开仓
使用ATR动态计算止损止盈，适应不同品种波动特性
增加成交量或动量确认过滤，减少假突破信号
增加资金管理百分比仓位计算，替代固定手数
improvements_en: Add ATR volatility filter to avoid entries during low-volatility periods
Implement new bar detection logic to prevent duplicate entries on the same candle
Use ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit calculation to adapt to different instrument volatility
Add volume or momentum confirmation filter to reduce false breakout signals
Implement percentage-based position sizing for money management instead of fixed lot size

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡市中可能连续止损导致资金回撤
缺乏新增K线检测可能导致短时间内重复开仓放大风险
固定止损未适配品种波动率，可能在高波动品种上止损过近被扫
risk_points_en: Breakout strategy may incur consecutive stop-outs in ranging markets, leading to significant drawdown
Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate position openings in short timeframes, amplifying risk
Fixed stop-loss not adapted to instrument volatility may result in stops being too tight on volatile instruments, getting triggered prematurely

summary_en: This EA implements a breakout trading strategy that identifies price range boundaries and enters positions when price breaks out of the established range. It places pending orders or market orders at range extremes with predefined stop-loss and take-profit levels, aiming to capture momentum-driven moves after a consolidation phase.
